sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Allow standalone install (split-less APK)
Removes Pdb's base-APK split requirement (requiredSplitTypes=base__abi,base__density) so the single patched APK installs. Required when patching the App Bundle's base APK.
Bypass PairIP license check
Disables Pdb's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (pdb.app.App).
Chat button on profiles
Adds a 'Chat' entry to the profile screen's ⋯ menu: opens your conversation with that user when one exists, otherwise their profile (channels are server-created — no fake channel making).
Disable trackers
Disables Google Analytics measurement and Yandex AppMetrica telemetry, and turns off Crashlytics/Analytics data collection via their official opt-out flags.
Fix app icon
Gives the default launcher icon a real foreground. The base APK ships an adaptive icon with a null foreground (the visible icon normally comes from a theme alias enabled at runtime).
Floating power button
Adds a draggable quick-actions bubble to the main screen (profile IDs / receipts / pause toggles, copy your profile id, open Pdb Extras). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Quick → 'Show floating power button'.
Mock Pro (client-side)

Forces the app's client-side pro flag (isProUser → true) and the local ProStatus model: premium-badge UI, client-gated perks (unlimited rewinds, hide online, extra IRL slots) and pro-only screens open. Honestly: features the SERVER re-vali…
No profile-visitor limit

Lifts Pdb's client-side cap of 3 profile-visitor views per hour (the 'slow down' sheet). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Limits → 'No profile-visitor limit'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is on.
Pdb Extras feature menu
Adds a single Pdb Extras entry to the top of Pdb's Settings screen.
Pdb Extras — resources
Adds the Pdb Extras entry to the Settings screen and registers the extension components.
Remove ads
Disables Pdb's ad SDKs (GMS, AppLovin, Vungle, Yandex, Pangle) and turns off in-app ad initialisation.
Show profile IDs on names

Appends the numeric profile id (#1234567) after every profile name — Soul cards, chat headers, lists. Toggle: Pdb Extras → 'Show profile IDs on names'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is enabled, so the toggle wo…
Soul history
Records every Soul profile you see or like into a local, on-device history (Pdb Extras / power button → 'Soul history'), so swipes survive the server's short feed window.
